# Captured decision fixtures

These captures contain genuine responses from a locally hosted model and
synthetic test inputs. Endpoint names, addresses and machine paths were redacted
for redistribution. Request state, questions, answers, probabilities and token
usage are unchanged.

The fixtures exercise serialization, scoring, evaluation, blocking and process
recovery offline. They do not establish current service reachability or model
quality. Compatibility checks pin the sanitized response capture's BLAKE3 digest.
